summary: Large avalanche at Cameron Pass in the South Diamond Peak/Montgomery Bowl area; one man suffered a knee injury and refused medical aid on scene; the same night two overdue skiers were reported missing (11:10 p.m.) and called in at 12:24 a.m. after a 12-hour trail ordeal
location: Cameron Pass, South Diamond Peak/Montgomery Bowl
responding_agency: Larimer County SAR; LCSO Emergency Services (Jackson County SO, CPW assisted)
notes: Date = Saturday per the article (report 12:30 p.m. Feb 2; overdue-skier callout 11:10 p.m. Saturday, resolved 12:24 a.m.); 2013-02-02 was a Saturday. One operational period = one row per convention.
